name: ESP S300 Raptor (ESP Raptor, 300 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC w/o tip, printed ".142 (O89)". Without the tip installed, determined at 50 yards (page footnote). Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G1 BC w/tip, printed ".250". With the tip installed, determined at 250 yards (page footnote). No method mark: method not stated. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 8, Enhanced System Projectile (ESP): Caliber .458, Grains 300, Minimum Required Twist 1-20", Part Number ESP S300 Raptor, G1 BC w/o tip .142 (O89), G1 BC w/tip .250, OAL w/o tip 1.103", OAL w/tip 1.452", Bullet Projection w/o tip .251", Bullet Projection w/tip .650", Blunt Trauma Base™ ~ Retained Weight (grains) 219

note: Also printed: OAL w/o tip 1.103" (the length stored is with the tip). Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: w/o tip .251"; w/tip .650".
